pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed stellate and amoeboid geometries with high-frequency jagged edge boundaries. Patches exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions from dark brown to light cream.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space pathways forming a complex branching network. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the visible upper neck and shoulder, defined by a short, dark, dense mane silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Terminal tail tuft composed of long, dark hairs is positioned dorsally across the posterior flank/rump region.
